channel.title: Azure on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Azure on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network Manager IPAM in additional Azure regions
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network Manager IP address management is now generally available in additional regions: US Gov Virginia, US Gov Texas, US Gov Arizona, China North 3, and China East 3.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Multicloud Interconnect
item.description:
Azure Multicloud Interconnect is now in public preview. It provides managed private connectivity between Azure and supported cloud providers, with AWS as the first provider available in preview.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure VM Image Builder in sovereign and air-gapped clouds
item.description:
Azure VM Image Builder is now generally available in Azure Government, China North 3, Azure Government Secret, and Azure Government Top Secret. The service can be used across these sovereign and air-gapped environments with the same managed image-building experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SRE Agent VNet Integration
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent VNet Integration is now generally available. It lets the agent operate within existing network controls such as NSGs, private DNS, and firewall policies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SRE Agent 30-Day Trial
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent is now generally available with a 30-day trial for new customers. The trial lets users create agents, connect operational tools and data sources, and evaluate the product at their own pace.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Aspire 13.5 has shipped
item.description:
Aspire 13.5 has shipped. This release refreshes the dashboard and aspire.dev, expands the Interaction Service, adds cross-scope Azure references and persistent Kubernetes volumes, and introduces live terminals in the apphost.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure 248 and 372 vCPU sizes for D/E v7 series VMs
item.description:
Azure has generally available 248- and 372-vCPU D/E v7 VM sizes in the Dlsv7, Dsv7, Elsv7, and Esv7 families, powered by Intel Xeon 6 processors. Microsoft says these sizes provide up to 20% better compute performance than prior Intel-based v6 VMs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Extended Support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now offers Extended Support to keep workloads on supported PostgreSQL versions while you transition to newer releases. It includes critical security updates, critical bug fixes, and technical support.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Custom block response code and body for Application Gateway WAF
item.description:
Azure WAF on Application Gateway is now generally available with support for custom block response status codes and response bodies for blocked requests. This lets you define the HTTP response returned when WAF blocks a request.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Summarized advertised gateway prefixes for route advertisement
item.description:
Azure Gateway now generally supports advertising summarized (aggregated) prefixes to on-premises networks instead of advertising every individual virtual network prefix. This is available for route advertisement in Azure gateways.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure Copilot introduces direct access to agents
item.description:
Starting in August 2026, Azure Copilot will let customers interact directly with agents to move from questions to actions faster. Users can choose the agent best suited to their goal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure VMware Solution License-included service will be retired August 30, 2027
item.description:
Azure VMware Solution license-included service will be retired on August 30, 2027. The change follows Broadcom’s updated VMware licensing policy requiring customers on hyperscaler platforms to bring their own portable VMware Cloud Foundation license.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Managed Instance on Azure App Service
item.description:
Managed Instance on Azure App Service is now generally available. It is intended to help migrate web applications from on-premises or virtual machines to Azure App Service with minimal configuration and no code changes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: From single call to agents: five new Claude capabilities now available in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now supports five new Claude capabilities on Azure-hosted models: structured outputs, web search, web fetch, MCP connector, and tool search. The update positions a model endpoint for agent-style workflows rather than single-call usage.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Live Resize for Shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Data Disks
item.description:
Live Resize is now generally available for shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks. It lets you expand disk capacity dynamically without application disruption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: From Sync APIs to support for the GPT-5 model series and agentic workflows: What’s new in Azure Content Understanding – August 2026
item.description:
Azure Content Understanding gained support for the GPT-5 model series and agentic workflows, along with Sync APIs. The release focuses on helping developers extract structured, grounded data from enterprise content across documents, forms, tables, images, audio, and video.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: aks: Release 2026-08-07
item.description:
AKS release v20260807 adds Node Auto Provisioning support for restricted publicNetworkAccess clusters, global automatic availability zone placement, control-plane-only upgrades to AKS LTS, and GA node pool rollback. It also includes several behavioral changes that can trigger immediate node reimages on Kubernetes 1.37+, plus component and image updates.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard
item.description:
Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard is in public preview for ExpressRoute virtual network gateways. A new resiliency model property lets you declare whether a gateway is for single-homed or multi-homed configurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SharePoint Connector for Azure Databricks
item.description:
The SharePoint connector for Azure Databricks is now generally available. It can be used through Lakeflow Connect to ingest files from SharePoint into Azure Databricks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Nested confidential (cc_v5) VMs will be retired on September 1, 2026
item.description:
Azure will retire the cc_v5 confidential VM series on September 1, 2026. After that date, the affected VM sizes will no longer be available for use or purchase, and any impacted VM not resized beforehand will be deallocated.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Perimeter link feature in network security perimeter
item.description:
Microsoft Azure added a public preview of Perimeter link (cross-perimeter connectivity) for network security perimeter. It lets trusted resources in different perimeters communicate securely using Managed Identity (MSI) without adding extra network access rules.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Private Link support over IPv6
item.description:
Azure Private Link now supports IPv6 in public preview. IPv6 private endpoints can be used from IPv6 clients in an Azure virtual network to privately access Azure PaaS services such as Azure Storage and Azure SQL Database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network routing appliance
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network routing appliance is now generally available. It provides private connectivity across virtual networks using specialized hardware designed for low latency, high throughput, and improved performance versus virtual machines.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Trusted Launch as Default
item.description:
Trusted Launch as Default is now generally available for new Azure Gen2 virtual machines and virtual machine scale sets. It automatically enables Secure Boot and vTPM for supported deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Reservation exchanges for Azure services supported by savings plans will no longer be available starting February 1, 2027
item.description:
Azure will stop allowing reservation exchanges for services covered by savings plans starting February 1, 2027. At announcement time, this applies to Azure Virtual Machine compute reservations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — July update
item.description:
GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio’s July 2026 update adds a new agent built on the Copilot SDK, plus built-in expertise from the .NET and Azure teams. It also adds more options to tailor Copilot to individual workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Enclave
item.description:
Azure Enclave is now in public preview for Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, Azure Government Secret, and Azure Government Top Secret. It is intended to simplify deployment and management of isolated cloud environments for sensitive workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: NAT64 on StandardV2 NAT Gateway
item.description:
StandardV2 NAT Gateway now supports NAT64. This lets IPv6 workloads reach IPv4-only internet destinations by translating synthesized outbound IPv6 traffic to IPv4, using a DNS64-capable resolver.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Prepared Image Specification
item.description:
Azure announces a public preview of Prepared Image Specification for AKS workloads that need faster node startup. The feature is aimed at reducing delays caused by repeated container image downloads and initialization on new nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Gateway in Azure API Management
item.description:
Azure API Management now has an AI Gateway tier in public preview. It is a dedicated tier designed for AI workloads, extending AI gateway capabilities already available in other API Management tiers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection custom policy
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection custom policy is in public preview. It lets customers set per-resource DDoS mitigation thresholds for protected Standard Load Balancer frontend IP configurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Standard service endpoint is in public preview. It provides a more scalable and secure way to connect IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services within the Private Link family, addressing scale and management limits of earlier approaches.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Public Preview: Azure Functions Support for PowerShell 7.6
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports PowerShell 7.6 in public preview. You can develop locally with PowerShell 7.6 and deploy to Azure Functions plans.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Episodic procedural memory in Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now has episodic procedural memory in public preview. It stores successful task patterns so agents can reuse past action sequences, tool choices, and related context on similar future requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced platform metrics in Azure Monitor
item.description:
Azure Monitor now has advanced platform metrics in Public Preview starting July 15, 2026. The preview adds improved visibility into platform performance, resource health, and operational trends for supported Azure services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Databricks SQL Serverless in UK West
item.description:
Azure Databricks SQL Serverless is now generally available in the UK West region starting July 13, 2026. Eligible UK West workspaces can use it for analytics workloads with instant compute, automated scaling, and less infrastructure management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Exceptions in WAF for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door
item.description:
Azure Web Application Firewall now has an exceptions feature in public preview for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door. It lets you allow specific requests that would otherwise be blocked as false positives, complementing existing exclusions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Export historical data from Log Analytics workspace with Export jobs
item.description:
Azure Log Analytics now has a public preview Export job feature for exporting historical workspace data to an Azure Storage account. Exports are driven by a query and time range so you can retrieve only the needed data for external use.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: New Powershell module: Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer
item.description:
Azure announced the generally available Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer PowerShell module, a renamed module for managing Azure Database for PostgreSQL with PowerShell. It replaces the previous Az.PostgreSql-related module naming with a more streamlined experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Instant Access via application consistent restore points
item.description:
Azure added Instant Access for VM Restore Points in public preview. It lets you restore disks immediately after a restore point is created, without waiting for background replication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Migrate from Azure Blueprints by January 31, 2027
item.description:
Azure Blueprints retirement has been extended from July 11, 2026 to January 31, 2027. Phased retirement starts July 31, 2026, when creating new blueprint definitions will no longer be supported.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Application Gateway for Containers – Inference gateway
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers is adding a preview inference gateway capability. It brings the Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension to support AI inference traffic handling for Kubernetes workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Azure NetApp Files migration assistant
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files migration assistant is in preview and available generally, using SnapMirror for data migration to ANF. It supports migrations from on-premises systems and from CVO or other cloud providers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: Beyond the benchmark: Advancing security at AI speed
item.description:
Microsoft Security says it has advanced its agentic vulnerability detection system, MDASH, and integrated it into workflows across Windows, Azure, and identity systems. The post focuses on applying the system in real-world security operations rather than benchmark results.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: ICMP Support for Azure Standard V2 NAT Gateway
item.description:
Azure StandardV2 NAT Gateway now supports outbound ICMP Echo Request and Echo Reply traffic. This lets customers use tools like ping to validate outbound connectivity and troubleshoot network issues from workloads behind the gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Log Analytics Summary Rules experience
item.description:
A new Azure portal experience for Summary Rules in Log Analytics is now generally available. Summary Rules aggregate high-volume log data on a defined schedule and store it in summarized tables for faster querying and reporting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: D-series, Ds-series, Dv2-series, Dsv2-series, and Ls-series Virtual Machines for Azure Batch pools
item.description:
Azure Compute will retire D-series, Ds-series, Dv2-series, Dsv2-series, and Ls-series VMs for Azure Batch pools on May 1, 2028. After that date, new Batch pools cannot be created with these VM series.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL MCP Server
item.description:
SQL MCP Server is now generally available. It provides a secure, high-performance way to build agentic solutions with controlled access to production data, and supports SQL with compatibility for PostgreSQL and Azure Cosmos DB.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure VPN Client for Linux (Preview) will be retired on August 31, 2026
item.description:
Azure VPN Client for Linux (Preview) will be retired on August 31, 2026 because it has remained in preview and has no path to general availability. The notice says the retirement is part of aligning Azure networking services with current security and reliability standards.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent mode for GitHub Copilot in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Agent mode is now in public preview in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). It can help investigate performance issues, tune queries, review maintenance and configuration, identify security concerns, troubleshoot errors, and assist with operational tasks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: PostgreSQL Hub for Azure Developers
item.description:
PostgreSQL Hub for Azure Developers is now generally available. It provides a centralized set of AI and application development resources for PostgreSQL on Azure, including sample apps, solution accelerators, tutorials, and learning paths.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure NC RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition v6 Series Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure NCv6-series virtual machines are now generally available in Southeast Asia and West US 2. They use NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs with 96 GB of memory per GPU.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Premium SSD v2 disks now support non-zonal Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure Premium SSD v2 disks are now generally available for non-zonal, single-instance Azure virtual machines in select regions that have Availability Zones. This lets customers deploy Premium SSD v2 without choosing an Availability Zone.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ingestion Volume Change dashboard in Metrics Usage Insights
item.description:
Metrics Usage Insights now has an Ingestion Volume Change dashboard in public preview. It lets you compare ingestion volume over time to spot spikes or drops in time series counts and event ingestion rates.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Guest RDMA on Azure Boost
item.description:
Guest RDMA is in private preview on Azure in UK South. It uses Azure Boost to enable RDMA in the guest OS for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency networking within the same region.

  • Source: Azure Updates
